**5 Things You Can See:**
Start by naming five things you can see around you. It could be anything — the light on your phone, the wall, your hands, or something in the distance.

**4 Things You Can Feel:**
Now, identify four things you can feel — for example, the texture of your clothes, the air on your skin, or the surface you're sitting on.

**3 Things You Can Hear:**
Next, name three things you can hear. It could be the hum of a fan, traffic outside, or even your own breathing.

**2 Things You Can Smell:**
If you can, notice two things you can smell — the air, your room, or maybe something nearby.

**1 Thing You Can Taste:**
